{{Top|leg}}
'''Bistate gel''', also known as '''thermal gel''', was a protective gel like substance. Bistate gel was used in the shells of [[cocoon pod]]s to secure a [[Mountain Terrain Armored Transport]] during re-entry. Deployed from dispensors inside the cocoon pod, the bistate gel hardened and absorbed the kinetic energy upon the impact of landing.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> When deployed, the MT-AT would emerge from the cocoon pod covered in the bistate gel. In this way, the "birth" of the vehicle into combat was organic-looking.<ref name="FF74">{{FactFile|74|MTA 1-2|Mountain Terrain Armored Transport (MT-AT)}}</ref>
